claims.question: q1
claims.claim: Recent field studies show meaningful gains in coding activity, but the evidence indicates those gains attenuate sharply between writing code and shipping reliable software.
claims.quote: Recent field studies show meaningful gains in coding activity, but newer evidence also shows that those gains attenuate sharply between writing code and shipping reliable software.

claims.question: q1
claims.claim: Review, integration, testing, security, deployment, and production operations remain constraining stages, while costs shift from per-seat licensing to variable token, tool, sandbox, CI, and rework costs.
claims.quote: Review, integration, testing, security, deployment, and production operations remain constraining stages, while the economics are shifting from predictable per-seat licensing toward variable token, tool, sandbox, CI, and rework costs.

claims.question: q3
claims.claim: The paper proposes an Agentic SDLC Control Plane that allocates autonomy subject to cost, reliability, and human-attention budgets, alongside concepts including the Verification Tax and Production-Qualified Change.
claims.quote: The synthesis proposes four engineering concepts: the Agentic SDLC Throughput Paradox, Production-Qualified Change (PQC), the Verification Tax, and an Agentic SDLC Control Plane that allocates autonomy subject to cost, reliability, and human-attention budgets.

claims.question: q5
claims.claim: The paper is a synthesis of peer-reviewed software-engineering research, university studies, benchmark audits, production reports, developer telemetry, and cost-management evidence mainly from 2024 through September 2026.
claims.quote: This paper synthesizes peer-reviewed software-engineering research, university studies, benchmark audits, production reports from major technology companies, developer telemetry, and cost-management evidence released primarily from 2024 through September 2026.

claims.question: q5
claims.claim: The paper claims no new model experiment and attributes numerical findings to the original studies.
claims.quote: No new model experiment is claimed; numerical findings remain attributed to their original studies.
